about: Race Board (Henry, Nov 9): a 60-square race. questions = its own bank per level, 165 each (Henry, Nov 10: the old M.1 set was removed, old M.2 became M.1, old M.3 became M.2, and M.3 is a new harder set). A wrong answer rolls the back die. With a unit picked on the setup screen, the unit's questions are used instead (tiers guessed: A-D = regular, short answer or double = hard). Exact roll to finish (extra steps bounce back). The How to play slides live here too.

intro.title: Race Board
text: Every team has a piece on START.
First team to land exactly on FINISH wins!

intro.title: Your turn
text: Answer one question. Harder questions = bigger dice!
Wrong? Roll the back dice and move back.

intro.title: Special squares
text: ★ forward · ⚠ back · 🎲 roll again · ? chance card.

intro.title: Exact finish
text: You need the exact number to land on FINISH.
Too many? Bounce back the extra squares.
